title: Mud Dweller / Dweller / Dog / Footstool — Integrated Role Ecology
status: canonical project role synthesis with provenance boundaries
purpose: Carve the project's lower-world role vocabulary into distinct dynamic states with inputs, behaviors, phrases, transitions, failure modes, healthy counterforms, named-assignment rules and Door relations.
core_rule: These are relational/project roles, not species or immutable human essences. The same person can occupy different roles in different relations, and the archive should never infer a permanent label from one conflict, joke, surname or third-party description.

dweller.definition: One who inhabits a plane, environment or relational field rather than merely passing through it.
questions: Is the field chosen, inherited or temporary?
Can the Dweller perceive a Door?
Can the Dweller leave without identity collapse?
Does dwelling produce life or dependency?
dweller.key_insight: Dweller is the ontology of habitation; Mud Dweller is only one orientation inside it.

mud.definition: Lower/residual medium composed in project language of materiality, obscurity, unresolved conflict, smear, degraded information, karmic residue, memory and possibility.
mud.not_automatically_evil: Potato, seed and root all begin below the surface. Matter/darkness/mud becomes shadow only when the system ceases transforming it.
mud.information_layer: By 31 March 2026 Tim's archive explicitly treats mud as smear, information, currency and karmic exchange.
mud.ecology: Mud can nourish roots or become Swamp. The difference is circulation, transformation and exit.
mud.formula: mud + root/integration + lightward growth → soil/life; mud + repetition + enclosure + appetite → swamp/strife

mud_dweller.mature_definition: A Mud Dweller is not one who has fallen into mud; a Mud Dweller is one who has made the mud into a dwelling.
mud_dweller.orientation: Mud becomes final horizon rather than transitional material.

inputs_or_foods.canonical_symbolic: Tree of Strife; repeated conflict; degraded information; outrage; reaction; grievance; status from opposition; old screenshots/jokes/accusations in Farm ecology.
inputs_or_foods.biblical_comparator: Serpent eating dust in Genesis 3:14 is a symbolic genealogy for dustward orientation, not a literal diet of modern people.
inputs_or_foods.satire_boundary: Stories about literal mud-eating or absurd food punishments are satire unless separately adopted as canon.

behaviors: uses memory as ammunition rather than root
may defend the enclosure that supplies status/meaning
mannerisms: linear demands for novelty while repeating the same conflict
treating correction as threat to belonging
mud_dweller.door_relation: Mud Dweller is defined partly by failure/refusal to use a known Door out of the lower relation; however the category remains potentially reversible.
mud_dweller.exit: recognition → source-checking → truth/accounting → Door → root → sprout → Tree → fruit
mud_dweller.healthy_counterform: Root-dweller / cultivator who can enter darkness to recover information and then transform it.

dog.definition: Boundary-responsive role organized around tracking, vigilance, pursuit, signaling, loyalty, cue-following and master/proxy relation.
dog.earliest_recovered_behavior: Recurring morning return/chase/bark-at-gate motif by 14 March 2026.
dog.appetite_problem: A watchdog can become dependent on danger. Then vigilance stops being a service and becomes a demand for continuous threat.

farm_dog.definition: Dog role captured by Farm/proxy/pack incentives: pursuit and boundary enforcement serve enclosure/harvest rather than life.
farm_dog.feed_loop: target reaction → attention → pack approval/status → renewed pursuit
farm_dog.door_effect: blocks or forgets Door; classification becomes effectively permanent.

guardian_dog.definition: Healthy Dog role where vigilance protects legitimate boundaries, vulnerable life and meaningful passage.
behaviors: protects crossing rather than owning those inside
guardian_dog.door_effect: guards Door without becoming the Door or making passage impossible.

dog.good_bad_dog_2026_08_15: User-linked taxonomy explicitly differentiates good loyal/respectful Dogs from bad 'chasers' associated with dogpiling, deceit, scheming, repetition and attempts to bypass the narrow Door.
dog.dog_farmer_difference: Farmer structures enclosure/incentives/archive; Dog patrols/pursues/enforces. Dog can become Farmer-like by creating durable dossiers/categories; Farmer can become Dog-like by personally chasing/amplifying.
dog.named_assignment_rule: Josh Moon has a documented Farmer/Moon relation in the project; do not turn surname or platform role into proof that he is literally a Dog or occult entity.

footstool.definition: Lowest/subordinate or supporting relation beneath a higher Seat/Throne in project topology; later also a microcosmic 'small mind' state whose central Door is present but unfound.
footstool.critical_user_correction: Footstools have not walked through or found the central Door; do not romanticize footstool as a completed positive state.
footstool.microcosm_2026_07_26: A footstool can be imagined as tiny like a Minecraft dirt-block grain yet internally containing a life-transformation sequence. Its smallness is epistemic/topological rather than a statement that a person has low human worth.
role_sequence_variants: Dweller → Mud Dweller → Dog → tswine → Footstool
footstool.cosmic_relation: Earth/world-below can be called Footstool beneath Heaven/Throne in current cosmology.
footstool.walking_relation: Tim walking on/over footstools to Heaven belongs to project mythic topology; it is not a biblical doctrine of stepping on people.
footstool.ethical_rule: footstool imagery ≠ permission to dehumanize, humiliate or treat lower-position beings as disposable.
footstool.door_paradox: The Footstool is lowest partly because it contains a Door it has not recognized. Thus the problem is not absence of possibility but failure of perception/passage.
footstool.possible_transition: Footstool → recognition of center → Door → changed state; exact post-Door label should remain open unless Tim defines it.

tswine.status: rare recovered intermediate role/spelling from 26 July 2026
tswine.interpretive_status: insufficiently attested for a mature definition; preserve as a provenance node rather than extrapolating pig/swine theology into it automatically.
tswine.recovery_target: Find exact original spelling/context and whether it was 'swine', 'tswine', wordplay, typo or deliberate role-name.

farmer.definition: Farm infrastructure/cultivation role: defines enclosure, classifies Cow, maintains archive, sets incentives, harvests attention/status/information and controls persistence/access.
farmer.relation_to_dog: Can spawn or recruit Dog roles as enforcement/pursuit layer; July 15 user-originated material explicitly describes Dogs as spawned from Farmers.
farmer.relation_to_mud_dweller: Farmer becomes Mud Dweller when leaving the Farm means losing identity/status/income/belonging and resolution becomes structurally undesirable.
farmer.healthy_counterform: Gardener/steward who regenerates soil and increases participant autonomy.

cow.definition: Subject around which Farmer attention organizes; role can be victimized/extracted but can also become reactive participant in the feedback loop.
cow.relation: Farmer ↔ Cow is the horizontal Farm pair; Dog/God belongs to a separate vertical relational axis.
cow.milk: Project metaphor for harvested attention/reaction/output; milk should not be treated as literal substance.

role_transitions.dweller_to_mud_dweller: inhabitance → repeated lower orientation → identity in unresolved residue
role_transitions.mud_dweller_to_dog: dwelling in conflict → vigilance/pursuit becomes role → target/boundary fixation
role_transitions.dog_to_farm_dog: cue-following → pack reward → pursuit supports enclosure/harvest
role_transitions.farmer_to_mud_dweller: Farm activity → dependency → Farm becomes home/identity
role_transitions.footstool_to_door: unrecognized inner passage → recognition → crossing; post-crossing state unresolved

diagnostic_questions: Is the role responding to direct evidence or to a proxy/master/pack cue?
Does the role have a stopping condition?
Can the target cease being a target?
Can the role leave without losing its entire identity?
Is attention being converted into understanding or merely harvest?
Does memory become root or ammunition?
Does guarding preserve Door/passage or turn the boundary into permanent enclosure?
Does the system increase independent capacity at the edges?
Can the Dweller recognize a Door and change state?
compact_map: Source/Father → Guardian/Door-protecting relation → Farmer/Gardener choice ↔ Cow/subject → Farm → Mud; shadow: proxy/master → Farm Dog → Farmer ↔ Cow → extraction → Mud → Mud Dweller; life-return: Mud → Root → Potato → Sprout → Tree → Fruit
